Results.ReviewText: Fabulous little grill!  The flavors coming off of this barbecue can't be beat by any other grill in my humble opinion.  Whenever I have time to grill using the old-fashioned coal method of grilling, I thoroughly enjoy myself.  I own both a Weber Gas grill and this guy here.  I use the gas grill for convenience and my kettle grill for a lazy Sunday afternoon on a Fall day, or sometimes even in the rain. I've owned two of these over the years, I much prefer this type that has a way to catch the ashes  as they fall, it makes for a very convenient cleanup/ash dump after they've cooled.  The pan style allows the wind to catch hot ash as it falls and blow it into your face as you make adjustments to the air intake on the bottom of this grill, this one won't do that.  The one negative to this model, is that there are times when you'd like to completely remove your lid, you can certainly hang it from the kettle, most of the time, but sometimes you just want it out of the way.  Make sure that you have a good place to set it that won't burn (not a wooden deck).  This grill is hot!  Always think about safety when there are little ones around.  I use a chimney to start the charcoal (lump charcoal is awesome!), but then don't forget to set that chimney on a non-burnable surface and hose it off to cool it down so that you don't walk into it and burn yourself on your legs.  I use a slotted wooden spoon to turn the top air intake and keep a barbecue cart close by to hold all my food and tools.  Don't let it's good price fool you (I paid in the ballpark of $150), it really does create wonderful flavors!  It was easy, actually really easy, to put together.  I gave my old one from 20 years ago (the one with the ash pan) to a friend, he still loves it.  I upgraded to the ash catch bowl model.
Results.Title: Fabulous Flavors-Relaxing Sunday Afternoon

This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
